mapping_note: Initial camera-role mapping based on visual inspection of representative frames. Reviewers/operators can update roles, zones, and line positions without code changes.

CAM_1.mapping_basis: Visual inspection shows skincare walls such as The Face Shop, Good Vibes, DermDoc, Minimalist and AquLogica.

CAM_2.mapping_basis: Visual inspection shows Lakme, Faces Canada, Maybelline, accessories and makeup browsing areas.

CAM_3.mapping_basis: Visual inspection shows glass entrance threshold and outside walkway.

CAM_4.mapping_basis: Visual inspection shows storage/backroom area, so this is excluded from customer metrics by default.

CAM_5.mapping_basis: Visual inspection shows cash counter, billing workstation and cashier-side activity.
